extraction.provider_name: Evergreen Summer Adventures (Evergreen Community Charter School)
extraction.notes: No summer 2027 information found. Official pages returned no readable body when opened; evidence was extracted from indexed official-page text. The 2026 homepage says rising Kinder–8th grade, while older welcome text on that same page says rising Kindergarten–9th grade; the card uses the 2026 announcement's range. Homepage states 2026 registration is closed, although the registration page still says all weeks have space. Homepage also warns of possible timing modifications; hours below are those on the registration page. FAQ contains a stale 2025 age cutoff, so ages are omitted. Archived enrichment and adventure pages were not treated as separate current offerings.

excluded.name: EverAfter
excluded.reason: School-year after-school childcare, not a summer camp.

cards.name: Evergreen Summer Adventures
cards.description: Campers participate in art, biking, creek play, climbing, gardening, hands-on STEM projects, and cooperative games. Older campers may take off-campus hiking trips.

season_dates.quote: June 22-26, July 6-10, July 13-17, July 20-24, and July 27-31.

grades.quote: Based at Evergreen but open to all kids rising Kinder-8th grade

prices.tier: Extended camp day; total weekly tuition

locations.name: Evergreen Community Charter School
locations.quote: Evergreen Community Charter School 50 Bell Road Asheville, NC, 28805

financial_aid.details: The FAQ says financial aid is not currently offered; occasional grant-supported partnerships are not generally open to public application.
financial_aid.quote: Evergreen Summer Adventures does not currently offer financial aid.

special_needs.details: Accommodation requests are reviewed case by case; parents should contact camp in advance.
special_needs.quote: Please let us know in advance of any particular concerns or of any accommodations that would be necessary for your child to attend, and we will work case-by-case to determine if we can provide a positive experience for your child.

lunch.details: Bring a morning snack and a full lunch; an afternoon snack may also be useful.
lunch.quote: Do you provide lunch? No. Campers should bring a morning snack and a full lunch.

availability.quote: Open registration for Summer 2026 is closed!
